gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.mechanism_finding: The collapse ROUTE differs by family but the OUTCOME does not. Non-OLMo damaged arms become constant-letter emitters with NEAR-ZERO exact ties (Llama-2 k12 is 100.0% modal with 0.00% ties; Qwen3 k12 is 99.1% modal with 0.03% ties). OLMo damaged arms reach the same place via 30.64% exact ties + argmax index tie-breaking. So ties are ONE road, not THE mechanism -- this over-determines the gate-3 refutation.
gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.content_also_fails: every damaged arm has content_norm within +/-3pp of its letter accuracy and both hover at their floors -- switching interface does NOT rescue a damaged arm

gate2_second_mc_benchmark.summary: On non-MMLU MC the interface/floor failure DOES reproduce. BoolQ's construct-appropriate null is 0.6217 (always-B), not 0.5: keep12/keep10/keep8 all sit BELOW it on the raw-LL interface and keep14 is n.s. (p=0.20) -> 4/6 arms indistinguishable from a constant predictor while their nominal 0.59-0.64 look 'passing' against a 0.50 chance line. OpenBookQA: longest-option null 0.3635 vs chance 0.2500; keep10 acc_norm 0.3560 is below that floor, and 3/15 arm-pair sign flips between acc and acc_norm. Residual fraction for base OBQA drops 45.9% -> 21.3% under the correct null (2.15x inflation from using chance).
gate2_second_mc_benchmark.caveat: The two interfaces used here are raw sum-LL vs length-normalised acc_norm, NOT MMLU's letter-vs-content. Report that difference explicitly; it is an analogous but not identical interface contrast.
gate2_second_mc_benchmark.negative_control: winogrande is structurally degenerate (both options share the continuation -> identical norm_lens, acc == acc_norm exactly, 100% tie rate). Cannot serve as an interface case; report as a control, not evidence.
gate2_second_mc_benchmark.clean_cases: CommonsenseQA (5-way) and SocialIQA (3-way): all 6 arms significantly ABOVE their constant-letter nulls on both interfaces -- the 'not everything collapses' side of the protocol.

claim_scope_after_gates.RETRACTED_must_narrow: An earlier version of this file said 'drop any claim that the letter MC interface is GENERALLY an unreliable instrument'. RETRACTED: that was based on INTACT bases only. The damaged-arm gate (6/6 non-OLMo below floor) confirms the general claim.
claim_scope_after_gates.must_drop: 'Exact ties are the mechanism of interface failure' as a family-general CAUSAL claim. Triple-falsified: (a) gate-3 base, ties 18->0 in fp32, acc unchanged p=1.000; (b) gate-3 keep8, ties 4303->0, 18% argmax flips, acc unchanged p=0.570, still below floor; (c) damaged non-OLMo collapse to the same place with 0.00-1.35% ties.
confirmed_general: Under structural damage the letter MC interface degenerates to at/below its own best-constant floor. Demonstrated on FOUR families: OLMo-2-7B (healed keep8, 0.2550), Llama-2-7B (trunc, 0.2295-0.2415), Llama-3-8B (trunc, 0.2329-0.2527), Qwen3-8B-Base (trunc, 0.2286-0.2301).
The collapse is a SHARP phase transition in depth, not a gradual decay -- Qwen3 is pinned at 0.2297 for keep 4..24 then jumps +45.74pp at keep30.
Interface swap does NOT rescue a damaged arm: content_norm sits within +/-3pp of letter on every damaged arm.

Report every construct against a construct-appropriate null (best-constant, not chance) before comparing arms. Demonstrations: keep8 0.2550 reads 'above chance' at .25 but is BELOW the 0.2689 floor; BoolQ 0.59-0.64 reads 'passing' at .50 but is below the 0.6217 always-B floor; OBQA residual fraction inflates 2.15x under the chance line.
gate-2's non-MMLU replication: the wrong-null problem is not an MMLU artifact.
The self-falsification narrative (using the protocol to retract one's own headline) -- now including this file's own retraction of the intact-only verdict.
family_specific_not_general: The collapse MECHANISM. OLMo-2 gets there via exact bf16 ties (30.64% on keep8) resolved by argmax index bias; Llama/Qwen get there via direct modal collapse with near-zero ties. Same destination, different road.

On HEALTHY strong models the letter interface is substantially BETTER than the label-free content interface (+13 to +23pp on OLMo-2 base, Llama-3, Qwen3). So 'content is the fair interface' is not a general statement about MC interfaces -- it is a statement about damaged models.
